decisions.reason: The mobile slow-speed shredder has survived its initial test period and fits the firm's core machinery and service base, so the option value of keeping it remains higher than the modest cost of carrying it.

After two years with weaker market visibility than the other launches and with newer screening options competing for attention, the product's prospects now look sufficiently revealed and limited to justify withdrawal.
This new multi-model shredder line is close to the established offer and still early in its market test, so uncertainty is high enough and holding costs low enough to keep the option open.

The spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's processing portfolio in a related direction, and as a recent launch with several models it still merits another year of learning before any abandonment decision.
